title: I'm Just Playing the Part of a Ruthless, Villainous Noble! ~Yet the Noble Ladies Meant to Oppose Me Keep Showering Me With Praise and Affection~
description:
Reincarnated as Zenos Allvain, history's strongest and most despicable noble destined to awaken the hero's cheat powers before meeting his own ruin, all I want is an early retirement to live peacefully as an ordinary nobody!

My plan was simple: follow the script, pull off every heinous 'villain move' imaginable, push the hero into awakening his powers, dump every world-ending problem onto his shoulders, and gracefully fade away into the background.

...Or so I thought.

"For your sake, Lord Zenos... I would do anything. Anything at all."
"I dedicate my entire being... body and soul... unto you!"

Instead of hating me, every noble lady and heroine who was supposed to be my sworn enemy has fallen head-over-heels in love with me!

Why is it that the harder I commit to being the ultimate villain, the more my popularity with women skyrockets?!
author: Kato Myojin
